tools/auditar_rc.py:
"""Audita o pacote portatil local sem extrair nem executar seu conteudo.

Uso: python tools/auditar_rc.py --zip dist/pacote.zip --report docs/auditoria.json
Requer somente a biblioteca padrao do Python. Os hashes verificam integridade,
nao autenticidade; o relatorio explicita os limites da inspecao de segredos.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import stat
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile


ENTRYPOINT = "com.projetok.prototype.DebugLauncher"
MAIN_JAR = "app/spirit-gate-arena.jar"
CLASS_PREFIXES = ("com/projetok/domain/", "com/projetok/prototype/")
HEX_SHA256 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$")
PRIVATE_PARTS = {
    ".git", ".svn", ".hg", ".ssh", ".aws", ".codex", ".agents", ".m2",
    "target", "test", "tests", "test-classes", "node_modules",
}
PRIVATE_SUFFIXES = {".pem", ".key", ".p12", ".pfx", ".jks", ".keystore"}
SECRET_PATTERNS = {
    "marcador_de_chave_privada": re.compile(
        rb"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |DSA |OPENSSH |ENCRYPTED )?PRIVATE KEY-----"
    ),
    "identificador_aws": re.compile(rb"(?<![A-Z0-9])(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}(?![A-Z0-9])"),
    "jdbc_com_credenciais_na_url": re.compile(
        rb"jdbc:[a-zA-Z0-9]+://[^\x00\s\"']{1,160}:[^\x00\s\"']{1,160}@"
    ),
    "jdbc_com_senha_na_query": re.compile(
        rb"jdbc:[^\x00\r\n]{1,500}[?;&](?:password|passwd|pwd)=[^\x00\s;&]+",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    ),
}
LIMITATIONS = [
    "Hashes e inventarios detectam divergencias, mas nao substituem assinatura "
    "digital nem autenticam um pacote e sidecars adulterados em conjunto.",
    "A busca de credenciais inspeciona somente o bytecode das classes do jogo, "
    "com padroes concretos; nao comprova ausencia absoluta de segredos, "
    "ofuscacao ou credenciais em outros formatos.",
    "A comparacao prova igualdade com server/target/classes no instante da "
    "auditoria; a compilacao recente dos fontes depende do mvn clean test "
    "registrado separadamente no processo de release.",
    "A auditoria nao executa o EXE e nao substitui a homologacao interativa "
    "em outro Windows sem Java ou Maven instalados.",
]


class AuditFailure(Exception):
    """Representa uma recusa de auditoria com mensagem sem dados sensiveis."""


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    """Interrompe a verificacao quando uma garantia necessaria nao e atendida."""
    if not condition:
        raise AuditFailure(message)


def sha256_stream(stream) -> str:
    """Calcula SHA-256 por blocos, sem carregar o runtime inteiro na memoria."""
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
        digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    """Calcula o resumo de um arquivo local somente para leitura."""
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return sha256_stream(stream)


def relative_name(name: str) -> str:
    """Valida um caminho de ZIP para extracao segura inclusive no Windows."""
    require(isinstance(name, str) and bool(name), "Caminho vazio no pacote.")
    require("\\" not in name and "\x00" not in name and ":" not in name,
            "Caminho nao portatil ou com fluxo alternativo no pacote.")
    require(not name.startswith("/"), "Caminho absoluto no pacote.")
    cleaned = name[:-1] if name.endswith("/") else name
    parts = cleaned.split("/")
    require(all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts),
            "Caminho relativo inseguro no pacote.")
    for part in parts:
        require(part.rstrip(" .") == part and not any(ord(c) < 32 for c in part) and
                not any(c in '<>"|?*' for c in part),
                "Nome incompativel com extracao segura no Windows.")
        stem = part.split(".", 1)[0].upper()
        require(not re.fullmatch(r"CON|PRN|AUX|NUL|CONIN\$|CONOUT\$|COM[1-9¹²³]|LPT[1-9¹²³]", stem),
                "Nome de dispositivo reservado no pacote.")
    return "/".join(parts)


def reject_private_path(name: str) -> None:
    """Recusa arquivos privados, fontes de teste e saidas de desenvolvimento."""
    for part in PurePosixPath(name).parts:
        lowered = part.casefold()
        require(lowered not in PRIVATE_PARTS and not lowered.startswith(".env"),
                f"Entrada privada ou de desenvolvimento: {name}")
        require(PurePosixPath(lowered).suffix not in PRIVATE_SUFFIXES,
                f"Extensao privada recusada: {name}")
    require(not name.casefold().endswith(("test.class", "tests.class")),
            f"Classe de teste recusada: {name}")


def archive_files(archive: zipfile.ZipFile) -> dict[str, zipfile.ZipInfo]:
    """Valida entradas antes de ler conteudo e detecta colisoes de nomes."""
    require(len(archive.infolist()) <= 50_000, "Numero excessivo de entradas no ZIP.")
    seen: set[str] = set()
    files = {}
    total_size = 0
    for item in archive.infolist():
        name = relative_name(item.orig_filename)
        require(name.casefold() not in seen, "Entradas duplicadas ou ambiguas no ZIP.")
        seen.add(name.casefold())
        reject_private_path(name)
        mode = item.external_attr >> 16
        require(not stat.S_ISLNK(mode), "Link simbolico recusado no pacote.")
        require(not item.flag_bits & 1, "Entrada criptografada recusada no pacote.")
        require(item.file_size <= 512 * 1024 * 1024, "Entrada excede o limite de auditoria.")
        total_size += item.file_size
        if not item.is_dir():
            files[name] = item
    require(total_size <= 2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024, "Pacote excede o limite de auditoria.")
    folded_files = {name.casefold() for name in files}
    for name in files:
        require(not any(parent.as_posix().casefold() in folded_files
                        for parent in PurePosixPath(name).parents
                        if parent != PurePosixPath(".")),
                "Arquivo usado tambem como diretorio no pacote.")
    return files


def json_object(data: bytes) -> dict:
    """Le JSON sem chaves duplicadas que tornariam o inventario ambiguo."""
    def unique_pairs(pairs):
        result = {}
        for key, value in pairs:
            require(key not in result, "Chave duplicada no manifest.")
            result[key] = value
        return result

    result = json.loads(data.decode("utf-8-sig"), object_pairs_hook=unique_pairs)
    require(isinstance(result, dict), "O manifest deve ser um objeto JSON.")
    return result


def main_manifest(data: bytes) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Interpreta o cabecalho principal do JAR, incluindo continuacoes."""
    lines = []
    for line in data.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line:
            break
        if line.startswith(" "):
            require(bool(lines), "Continuacao invalida no manifest do JAR.")
            lines[-1] += line[1:]
        else:
            lines.append(line)
    result = {}
    for line in lines:
        require(": " in line, "Cabecalho invalido no manifest do JAR.")
        key, value = line.split(": ", 1)
        require(key.casefold() not in result, "Cabecalho duplicado no manifest do JAR.")
        result[key.casefold()] = value
    return result


def audit(zip_path: Path, report: dict) -> None:
    """Executa a auditoria em etapas; falhas preservam os resultados anteriores."""
    def passed(identifier: str, **details) -> None:
        report["checks"].append({"id": identifier, "status": "PASS", **details})

    # --- Integridade do ZIP e estrutura segura antes de ler arquivos internos. ---
    require(zip_path.is_file(), "ZIP de entrada inexistente.")
    digest = sha256_file(zip_path)
    report["zipSha256"] = digest
    sidecar = Path(str(zip_path) + ".sha256")
    require(sidecar.is_file(), "Sidecar SHA-256 do ZIP ausente.")
    checksum_line = sidecar.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").strip()
    matched = re.fullmatch(r"([a-fA-F0-9]{64})[ \t]+\*?([^\r\n]+)", checksum_line)
    require(matched is not None, "Formato invalido no sidecar SHA-256.")
    require(matched.group(1).lower() == digest, "SHA-256 externo divergente do ZIP.")
    require(matched.group(2) == zip_path.name, "Sidecar SHA-256 identifica outro ZIP.")
    passed("zip_sha256_sidecar", sha256=digest, sizeBytes=zip_path.stat().st_size)

    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as archive:
        files = archive_files(archive)
        require(bool(files), "ZIP sem arquivos.")
        roots = {name.split("/", 1)[0] for name in files}
        require(roots == {"SpiritGate"}, "Esperada somente a raiz SpiritGate no ZIP.")
        relative = {name[len("SpiritGate/"):]: item for name, item in files.items()}
        required = {"manifest.json", "VERSION.txt", "INVENTARIO-SHA256.txt",
                    "LEIA-ME-TESTER.txt", "SpiritGate.exe", "app/SpiritGate.cfg",
                    MAIN_JAR, "runtime/release", "runtime/bin/server/jvm.dll"}
        require(required <= relative.keys(), "Arquivo obrigatorio ausente no pacote.")
        for name in relative:
            require(not name.casefold().endswith(".class"),
                    "Classe solta fora do JAR autorizado no pacote.")
            if name.casefold().endswith(".jar"):
                require(name in (MAIN_JAR, "runtime/lib/jrt-fs.jar"),
                        f"JAR extra nao autorizado no pacote: {name}")
        passed("estrutura_segura", files=len(files), root="SpiritGate")

        def read(name: str) -> bytes:
            return archive.read(relative[name])

        visual_names = {name for name in relative if name.startswith('visual/')}
        if visual_names:
            require(visual_names == {'visual/character.png', 'visual/character.properties', 'visual/review.json'},
                    'Whitelist do pacote visual divergente.')
            from pacote_visual import stage
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='spirit-visual-audit-') as directory:
                base = Path(directory)
                for name in ('character.png', 'character.properties', 'review.json'):
                    (base/name).write_bytes(read('visual/'+name))
                config = json_object((base/'review.json').read_bytes())
                require(len(config.get('assets', [])) == 1 and config['assets'][0].get('path') == 'character.png',
                        'Manifest visual deve usar imagem local fixa.')
                stage(base, base/'review.json', base/'checked')
                for name in ('character.png', 'character.properties', 'review.json'):
                    require((base/name).read_bytes() == (base/'checked'/name).read_bytes(),
                            'Pacote visual diverge da revisao por SHA.')
            passed('pacote_visual_aprovado_sha', files=3)

        # --- Manifest cobre o inventario; o inventario evita a circularidade. ---
        manifest_bytes = read("manifest.json")
        side_manifest = Path(str(zip_path) + ".manifest.json")
        require(side_manifest.is_file(), "Sidecar do manifest ausente.")
        require(side_manifest.read_bytes() == manifest_bytes,
                "Sidecar do manifest diverge do arquivo distribuido.")
        manifest = json_object(manifest_bytes)
        require(manifest.get("schemaVersion") == 1, "Schema desconhecido no manifest.")
        require(manifest.get("entrypoint") == ENTRYPOINT, "Entrypoint inesperado no manifest.")
        require(manifest.get("mainJar") == MAIN_JAR, "JAR principal inesperado no manifest.")
        require(manifest.get("platform") == "windows-x64", "Plataforma inesperada no manifest.")
        version = manifest.get("version")
        require(isinstance(version, str) and bool(version), "Versao invalida no manifest.")
        require(read("VERSION.txt").decode("utf-8-sig").strip() == version,
                "VERSION.txt diverge de manifest.version.")
        report["version"] = version
        listed = {}
        entries = manifest.get("files")
        require(isinstance(entries, list), "Inventario de arquivos ausente no manifest.")
        for item in entries:
            require(isinstance(item, dict), "Item invalido no inventario do manifest.")
            name = relative_name(item.get("path"))
            require(name not in listed and name != "manifest.json",
                    "Manifest lista a si mesmo ou contem duplicata.")
            require(name in relative, f"Manifest referencia arquivo inexistente: {name}")
            require(type(item.get("sizeBytes")) is int and item["sizeBytes"] >= 0,
                    f"Tamanho invalido no manifest: {name}")
            require(isinstance(item.get("sha256"), str) and HEX_SHA256.fullmatch(item["sha256"]),
                    f"SHA-256 invalido no manifest: {name}")
            require(relative[name].file_size == item["sizeBytes"],
                    f"Tamanho divergente do manifest: {name}")
            with archive.open(relative[name]) as stream:
                actual_hash = sha256_stream(stream)
            require(actual_hash == item["sha256"].lower(),
                    f"SHA-256 divergente do manifest: {name}")
            listed[name] = actual_hash
        require(set(listed) == set(relative) - {"manifest.json"},
                "Manifest nao cobre exatamente todos os arquivos exceto si mesmo.")
        inventory = {}
        for line in read("INVENTARIO-SHA256.txt").decode("utf-8-sig").splitlines():
            matched = re.fullmatch(r"([a-fA-F0-9]{64})  (.+)", line)
            require(matched is not None, "Linha invalida no inventario SHA-256.")
            name = relative_name(matched.group(2))
            require(name not in inventory, "Arquivo duplicado no inventario SHA-256.")
            inventory[name] = matched.group(1).lower()
        expected_inventory = {name: value for name, value in listed.items()
                              if name != "INVENTARIO-SHA256.txt"}
        require(inventory == expected_inventory,
                "Inventario SHA-256 divergente ou com circularidade.")
        passed("manifest_e_inventario", manifestFiles=len(listed),
               inventoryFiles=len(inventory), version=version,
               manifestSha256=hashlib.sha256(manifest_bytes).hexdigest())

        # --- JVM integrada, modulos e launcher: somente dados, sem execucao. ---
        release = dict(re.findall(r'^([A-Z_]+)="([^"\r\n]*)"',
                                 read("runtime/release").decode("utf-8"), re.MULTILINE))
        require(re.fullmatch(r"17(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z.+_-]+)?", release.get("JAVA_VERSION", "")),
                "Runtime integrado nao e Java 17.")
        require(manifest.get("javaVersion") == release["JAVA_VERSION"],
                "Versao Java do runtime diverge do manifest.")
        modules = release.get("MODULES", "").split()
        declared_modules = manifest.get("javaModules")
        require(isinstance(declared_modules, list) and
                all(isinstance(module, str) for module in declared_modules),
                "Lista de modulos invalida no manifest.")
        # O manifest registra as raizes passadas ao jlink; runtime/release inclui
        # tambem dependencias transitivas resolvidas, como java.datatransfer.
        require(len(set(declared_modules)) == len(declared_modules) and
                set(declared_modules) <= set(modules),
                "Modulo declarado no manifest ausente do runtime.")
        require({"java.base", "java.desktop", "jdk.random"} <= set(declared_modules),
                "Modulo obrigatorio nao declarado no manifest.")
        require({"java.base", "java.desktop", "jdk.random"} <= set(modules),
                "Modulo obrigatorio ausente no runtime integrado.")
        cfg = read("app/SpiritGate.cfg").decode("utf-8-sig")
        cfg_values = dict(re.findall(r"^([^=\r\n]+)=([^\r\n]*)", cfg, re.MULTILINE))
        require(cfg_values.get("app.mainclass") == ENTRYPOINT,
                "Launcher nao aponta para DebugLauncher.")
        require(cfg_values.get("app.classpath") in
                ("$APPDIR\\spirit-gate-arena.jar", "$APPDIR/spirit-gate-arena.jar"),
                "Classpath inesperado no launcher.")
        exe = read("SpiritGate.exe")
        require(len(exe) >= 64 and exe[:2] == b"MZ", "Launcher nao possui cabecalho PE.")
        pe_offset = struct.unpack_from("<I", exe, 0x3C)[0]
        require(pe_offset + 6 <= len(exe) and exe[pe_offset:pe_offset + 4] == b"PE\x00\x00" and
                struct.unpack_from("<H", exe, pe_offset + 4)[0] == 0x8664,
                "Launcher nao e Windows PE x64.")
        passed("runtime_e_launcher", javaVersion=release["JAVA_VERSION"],
               javaModules=sorted(modules), declaredRootModules=sorted(declared_modules),
               mainClass=ENTRYPOINT,
               launcherArchitecture="PE x64 (0x8664)")

        # --- Whitelist e igualdade de TODAS as classes com o checkout compilado. ---
        classes_directory = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "server" / "target" / "classes"
        expected_classes = {}
        for prefix in CLASS_PREFIXES:
            package = classes_directory.joinpath(*PurePosixPath(prefix).parts)
            require(package.is_dir(), "Classes locais ausentes; execute mvn clean test antes.")
            for path in package.rglob("*.class"):
                require(not path.is_symlink(), "Link simbolico nas classes locais.")
                expected_classes[path.relative_to(classes_directory).as_posix()] = path
        require(bool(expected_classes), "Nenhuma classe local encontrada para comparacao.")
        jar_classes = {}
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(read(MAIN_JAR))) as jar:
            jar_files = archive_files(jar)
            for item in jar.infolist():
                name = relative_name(item.orig_filename)
                require(name == "META-INF" or name.startswith("META-INF/") or
                        name in ("com/projetok/domain", "com/projetok/prototype") or
                        name.startswith(CLASS_PREFIXES), f"Entrada fora da whitelist do JAR: {name}")
            require("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF" in jar_files, "Manifest principal ausente no JAR.")
            attributes = main_manifest(jar.read("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF"))
            require(attributes.get("main-class") == ENTRYPOINT, "Main-Class inesperada no JAR.")
            for name in jar_files:
                if name.startswith("META-INF/"):
                    require(not name.casefold().endswith((".class", ".jar")),
                            "Codigo oculto sob META-INF no JAR.")
                    continue
                require(name.endswith(".class"), f"Recurso nao autorizado no JAR: {name}")
                data = jar.read(name)
                require(data.startswith(b"\xca\xfe\xba\xbe"), f"Bytecode invalido: {name}")
                require(len(data) >= 8 and struct.unpack_from(">H", data, 6)[0] <= 61,
                        f"Classe exige Java posterior ao 17: {name}")
                forbidden = (b"com/esotericsoftware/kryonet", b"com.esotericsoftware.kryonet",
                             b"org/postgresql", b"org.postgresql", b"DatabaseManager")
                require(not any(marker in data for marker in forbidden),
                        f"Referencia legada de banco ou rede no bytecode: {name}")
                for label, pattern in SECRET_PATTERNS.items():
                    require(not pattern.search(data),
                            f"Padrao concreto de credencial detectado ({label}) em {name}; "
                            "conteudo omitido.")
                jar_classes[name] = data
        require(set(jar_classes) == set(expected_classes),
                "Inventario de classes do JAR diverge das classes atuais domain/prototype.")
        for name, path in sorted(expected_classes.items()):
            require(jar_classes[name] == path.read_bytes(),
                    f"Bytecode do JAR nao corresponde ao checkout compilado atual: {name}")
        passed("jar_whitelist_e_bytecode_atual", classesCompared=len(jar_classes),
               comparison="Byte a byte, todas as classes domain/prototype, sem omissoes.",
               allowedPrefixes=list(CLASS_PREFIXES), mainClass=ENTRYPOINT)
        passed("credenciais_padronizadas_no_bytecode_do_jogo", classesScanned=len(jar_classes),
               patterns=list(SECRET_PATTERNS), findings=0,
               scope="Somente classes domain/prototype; conteudo encontrado nunca e impresso.")


def main() -> int:
    """Grava evidencia JSON tanto em sucesso quanto em recusa da auditoria."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--zip", required=True, type=Path, help="ZIP portatil e seus sidecars.")
    parser.add_argument("--report", required=True, type=Path, help="Relatorio JSON de saida.")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    zip_path = args.zip.resolve()
    report_path = args.report.resolve()
    protected = {zip_path, Path(str(zip_path) + ".sha256"), Path(str(zip_path) + ".manifest.json")}
    if report_path in protected:
        parser.error("O relatorio nao pode sobrescrever o ZIP nem seus sidecars.")
    report = {
        "schemaVersion": 1,
        "task": "TASK-012_016",
        "auditedAtUtc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "zip": str(zip_path),
        "status": "FAIL",
        "checks": [],
        "limitations": LIMITATIONS,
        "executedPackagedCode": False,
    }
    try:
        audit(zip_path, report)
        report["status"] = "PASS"
    except AuditFailure as failure:
        report["error"] = str(failure)
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, struct.error,
            zipfile.BadZipFile, RuntimeError) as failure:
        # Nao reproduz dados JSON, conteudo binario nem mensagens de bibliotecas
        # que possam conter trechos de um arquivo privado adulterado.
        report["error"] = "Falha de leitura ou formato: " + type(failure).__name__
    report_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Auditoria {report['status']}: {report_path}")
    if report["status"] != "PASS":
        print(report["error"], file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

tools/build-windows-portable.ps1:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Gera a arena portatil Windows x64 com Java 17 integrado, sem instalador.
.DESCRIPTION
Executa os testes por padrao. O JAR e montado apenas com domain e prototype:
as entradas legadas de servidor, banco e Kryonet nao pertencem a arena local.
Nao apaga diretorios e nunca sobrescreve uma distribuicao anterior.
.EXAMPLE
.\tools\build-windows-portable.cmd -Version 0.7.0-task007
.EXAMPLE
.\tools\build-windows-portable.ps1 -Version 0.11.0-rc1 -SkipMaven
.EXAMPLE
.\tools\build-windows-portable.cmd -Version 0.11.0-rc1 -TesterKitDirectory .\docs\kit-homologacao
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidatePattern('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$')]
    [string] $Version = '0.7.0-task007',
    [string] $JavaHome = '',
    [string] $TesterKitDirectory = '',
    [string] $MavenRepository = '',
    [string] $VisualManifest = '',
    [string] $VisualRoot = '',
    [switch] $SkipMaven
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$transcriptStarted = $false

# --- Ferramentas e caminhos: somente entradas locais explicitamente permitidas. ---

function Invoke-CheckedTool {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string] $Program,
        [string[]] $Arguments = @(),
        [switch] $Capture
    )
    $previousPreference = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    try {
        $lines = @(& $Program @Arguments 2>&1)
        $toolExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
    }
    finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $previousPreference
    }
    foreach ($line in $lines) { Write-Host $line.ToString() }
    if ($toolExitCode -ne 0) {
        throw "Ferramenta terminou com codigo ${toolExitCode}: $Program"
    }
    if ($Capture) { return @($lines | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }) }
}

function Assert-ChildPath {
    param([string] $Path, [string] $Parent)
    $absolute = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
    $prefix = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Parent).TrimEnd('\') + '\'
    if (-not $absolute.StartsWith($prefix, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        throw "Caminho de saida fora da pasta permitida: $absolute"
    }
    return $absolute
}

function Write-Utf8File {
    param([string] $Path, [string] $Content)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

function Get-PortableInventory {
    param([string] $Directory)
    $prefix = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Directory).TrimEnd('\') + '\'
    return @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Directory -Recurse -File |
        Sort-Object FullName | ForEach-Object {
            [ordered]@{
                path = $_.FullName.Substring($prefix.Length).Replace('\', '/')
                sizeBytes = $_.Length
                sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            }
        })
}

try {
    if ($env:OS -ne 'Windows_NT' -or -not [Environment]::Is64BitOperatingSystem) {
        throw 'O app-image exige uma maquina de build Windows x64.'
    }
    $projectDirectory = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..'))
    $serverDirectory = Join-Path $projectDirectory 'server'
    $distributionDirectory = Join-Path $projectDirectory 'dist'
    # O kit e opcional e usa somente estes tres nomes, sem copia recursiva.
    $testerKitFileNames = @('MODELO-RELATO-BUG.md', 'ROTEIRO-HOMOLOGACAO.md', 'CHANGELOG-RESUMIDO.md')
    $testerKitSources = @()
    if ($TesterKitDirectory) {
        $kitDirectory = Get-Item -LiteralPath $TesterKitDirectory -ErrorAction Stop
        if (-not $kitDirectory.PSIsContainer) { throw 'TesterKitDirectory deve apontar para uma pasta.' }
        # Mapa opcional de teste local; kits historicos de tres arquivos continuam validos.
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $kitDirectory.FullName 'mapa-demo.properties') -PathType Leaf) {
            $testerKitFileNames += 'mapa-demo.properties'
        }
        foreach ($fileName in $testerKitFileNames) {
            $kitFile = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $kitDirectory.FullName $fileName) -ErrorAction Stop
            if ($kitFile.PSIsContainer -or ($kitFile.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) {
                throw "Arquivo de homologacao deve ser um arquivo comum: $fileName"
            }
            # Rejeita codificacao invalida sem regravar nem substituir tokens.
            $strictUtf8 = New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false, $true)
            $null = $strictUtf8.GetString([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($kitFile.FullName))
            $testerKitSources += $kitFile
        }
    }
    if (-not $JavaHome) { $JavaHome = $env:JAVA_HOME }
    if (-not $JavaHome) {
        $JavaHome = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent (Get-Command java.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source)
    }
    $JavaHome = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $JavaHome).Path
    $releaseFile = Join-Path $JavaHome 'release'
    $release = Get-Content -LiteralPath $releaseFile -Raw
    if ($release -notmatch '(?m)^JAVA_VERSION="(17\.[^"]+)"') {
        throw 'Selecione um JDK 17 completo pelo parametro -JavaHome ou JAVA_HOME.'
    }
    $javaVersion = $Matches[1]
    if ($release -notmatch '(?m)^OS_ARCH="(x86_64|amd64)"') {
        throw 'O JDK selecionado deve ser Windows x64.'
    }
    $jdkBin = Join-Path $JavaHome 'bin'
    foreach ($name in @('java.exe', 'jar.exe', 'jdeps.exe', 'jlink.exe', 'jpackage.exe')) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $jdkBin $name) -PathType Leaf)) {
            throw "Ferramenta ausente no JDK 17: $name"
        }
    }
    $env:JAVA_HOME = $JavaHome
    $env:PATH = $jdkBin + ';' + $env:PATH
    $maven = (Get-Command mvn.cmd -ErrorAction Stop).Source

    # A versao completa identifica o ZIP; o recurso PE do Windows usa x.y.z.
    if ($Version -notmatch '^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)') {
        throw 'A versao deve comecar com tres numeros, por exemplo 0.7.0-task007.'
    }
    $windowsVersion = '{0}.{1}.{2}' -f $Matches[1], $Matches[2], $Matches[3]
    $buildId = $Version + '-' + [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ') + '-' +
        [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8)
    $artifactName = 'SpiritGate-' + $buildId + '-portable'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $distributionDirectory -Force | Out-Null
    $logPath = Assert-ChildPath (Join-Path $distributionDirectory ($artifactName + '-build.log')) $distributionDirectory
    Start-Transcript -LiteralPath $logPath -NoClobber | Out-Null
    $transcriptStarted = $true
    Write-Host "Spirit Gate $Version | Windows x64 | Java $javaVersion"
    Write-Host "JDK: $JavaHome"
    $mavenInformation = @(Invoke-CheckedTool $maven @('--version') -Capture)
    $jpackageVersion = @(Invoke-CheckedTool (Join-Path $jdkBin 'jpackage.exe') @('--version') -Capture)

    # --- Compilacao/testes e staging restrito da arena independente. ---

    Push-Location -LiteralPath $serverDirectory
    try {
        if (-not $SkipMaven) {
            $testArguments = @('clean', 'test')
            if ($MavenRepository) { $testArguments = @('-Dmaven.repo.local=' + [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($MavenRepository)) + $testArguments }
            Invoke-CheckedTool $maven $testArguments
        }
        else {
            Write-Host 'SkipMaven: reutilizando classes locais; execute mvn clean test antes deste modo.'
        }
    }
    finally { Pop-Location }
    $classesDirectory = Join-Path $serverDirectory 'target\classes'
    foreach ($package in @('domain', 'prototype')) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $classesDirectory ('com\projetok\' + $package)) -PathType Container)) {
            throw "Classes da arena ausentes: $package. Execute mvn clean test."
        }
    }
    # A arena atual desenha em Java2D e nao carrega recursos externos. Um recurso
    # futuro exige whitelist explicita; evita omissao silenciosa ou copia de config.
    $resourcesDirectory = Join-Path $serverDirectory 'src\main\resources'
    if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $resourcesDirectory) -and
        @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $resourcesDirectory -Recurse -File | Where-Object { -not $_.FullName.StartsWith((Join-Path $resourcesDirectory 'rpg') + '\', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }).Count -gt 0) {
        throw 'Foram encontrados recursos novos. Revise a whitelist de staging antes de distribuir.'
    }
    $buildRoot = Assert-ChildPath (Join-Path $serverDirectory ('target\portable-build-' + $buildId)) (Join-Path $serverDirectory 'target')
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $buildRoot) { throw "Saida ja existe: $buildRoot" }
    $jarInput = Join-Path $buildRoot 'input'
    $packageOutput = Join-Path $buildRoot 'app-image'
    $runtimeImage = Join-Path $buildRoot 'runtime-image'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $jarInput -Force | Out-Null
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $packageOutput -Force | Out-Null
    $jarName = 'spirit-gate-arena.jar'
    $jarPath = Join-Path $jarInput $jarName
    # O modo legado exclui explicitamente o subpacote RPG e seus recursos.
    $arenaClasses = Join-Path $buildRoot 'arena-classes'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $arenaClasses 'com\projetok\prototype') -Force | Out-Null
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $classesDirectory 'com\projetok\domain') -Destination (Join-Path $arenaClasses 'com\projetok\domain') -Recurse
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $classesDirectory 'com\projetok\prototype') -File | Copy-Item -Destination (Join-Path $arenaClasses 'com\projetok\prototype')
    Invoke-CheckedTool (Join-Path $jdkBin 'jar.exe') @('--create', '--file', $jarPath,
        '--main-class', 'com.projetok.prototype.DebugLauncher',
        '-C', $arenaClasses, 'com/projetok/domain',
        '-C', $arenaClasses, 'com/projetok/prototype')
    # jdeps falha caso uma classe incluida passe a exigir biblioteca externa.
    $dependencyArguments = @('--multi-release', '17', '--print-module-deps', $jarPath)
    $dependencyLines = @(Invoke-CheckedTool (Join-Path $jdkBin 'jdeps.exe') $dependencyArguments -Capture)
    $modules = @($dependencyLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(java|jdk)\.[a-z.,]+$' })
    if ($modules.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Nao foi possivel determinar os modulos Java da arena.' }
    # RandomGenerator.getDefault usa um provedor de servico de jdk.random;
    # jdeps nao o descobre por referencias estaticas a classes de java.base.
    $runtimeModules = @($modules[0].Split(',') + 'jdk.random' | Sort-Object -Unique) -join ','
    Invoke-CheckedTool (Join-Path $jdkBin 'jlink.exe') @('--add-modules', $runtimeModules,
        '--strip-debug', '--no-man-pages', '--no-header-files', '--compress=2', '--output', $runtimeImage)
    Invoke-CheckedTool (Join-Path $jdkBin 'jpackage.exe') @('--type', 'app-image',
        '--dest', $packageOutput, '--name', 'SpiritGate', '--input', $jarInput,
        '--main-jar', $jarName, '--main-class', 'com.projetok.prototype.DebugLauncher',
        '--runtime-image', $runtimeImage, '--app-version', $windowsVersion,
        '--vendor', 'Spirit Gate', '--description', 'Spirit Gate - arena local de testes')
    $appImage = Join-Path $packageOutput 'SpiritGate'
    # jpackage marca arquivos como somente leitura no Windows. Normaliza apenas
    # a saida criada por este build para que um futuro mvn clean possa remove-la.
    foreach ($generatedFile in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $buildRoot -Recurse -File) {
        $null = Assert-ChildPath $generatedFile.FullName $buildRoot
        if ($generatedFile.IsReadOnly) { $generatedFile.IsReadOnly = $false }
    }
    foreach ($required in @('SpiritGate.exe', 'app\SpiritGate.cfg', ('app\' + $jarName), 'runtime\release')) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $appImage $required) -PathType Leaf)) {
            throw "App-image incompleto: $required"
        }
    }

    # --- Kit do tester, inventario verificavel e distribuicao sem sobrescrita. ---

    if ($VisualManifest) {
        if (-not $VisualRoot) { throw 'VisualRoot obrigatorio com VisualManifest.' }
        Invoke-CheckedTool (Get-Command python -ErrorAction Stop).Source @(
            (Join-Path $projectDirectory 'tools\pacote_visual.py'),
            ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($VisualRoot)), ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($VisualManifest)),
            (Join-Path $appImage 'visual'))
    }

    $releaseNotice = if ($Version -match '(?i)(^|[._-])rc\d*($|[._-])') {
        'CANDIDATO A HOMOLOGACAO; NAO RELEASE PUBLICA'
    } else { 'PACOTE DE TESTES LOCAIS' }
    $readme = @"
SPIRIT GATE - ARENA LOCAL PORTATIL
Versao: $Version | Windows x64
$releaseNotice

1. Extraia o ZIP inteiro para uma pasta gravavel.
2. Abra SpiritGate.exe dentro da pasta SpiritGate. Nao mova somente o EXE.
3. Nao e necessario instalar Java, Maven, PostgreSQL ou conectar a um servidor.
4. F1 mostra ajuda; F2 permite salvar diagnostico ZIP local, sem envio automatico.
   Revise o JSON antes de compartilhar. Escolha nome novo para evitar sobrescrita.

Controles: WASD mover; Espaco atacar; E esforco (20 vigor);
Q Criostase (55 vigor); Shift Passo Relampago (35 vigor), mirando com mouse;
H mostrar hitboxes; R reiniciar. Feche a janela para sair.

Janela redimensionavel: arena logica 960x640, proporcao preservada e margens.
Mira Shift/Q usa coordenadas do mundo; HUD e margens nao sao alvos.
Mapa opcional: .\SpiritGate.exe --map mapa-demo.properties, se incluido no kit.
Camera/zoom de integracao nao altera fisica; mapas maiores apenas em testes.
Arte nao aprovada permanece fora do pacote; fallback geometrico e intencional.

Mantenha app/ e runtime/ junto ao EXE. O runtime Java 17 esta integrado.
O executavel nao e assinado; avisos do Windows podem ocorrer. Nao desative
protecoes. Confira a origem e o SHA-256 fornecido com a distribuicao.

Ao relatar um problema, informe versao, Windows, passos para reproduzir,
resultado esperado/obtido e captura se possivel. Nao envie credenciais.
Este pacote e candidato a testes locais, sem multiplayer e sem instalador.
Teste em outro Windows sem Java/Maven: PENDENTE DE HOMOLOGACAO HUMANA.
"@
    Write-Utf8File (Join-Path $appImage 'LEIA-ME-TESTER.txt') $readme
    Write-Utf8File (Join-Path $appImage 'VERSION.txt') ($Version + "`r`n")
    foreach ($kitFile in $testerKitSources) {
        $kitDestination = Assert-ChildPath (Join-Path $appImage $kitFile.Name) $appImage
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $kitDestination) {
            throw "Arquivo de homologacao ja existe na imagem: $($kitFile.Name)"
        }
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath $kitFile.FullName -Destination $kitDestination -ErrorAction Stop
        $copiedKitFile = Get-Item -LiteralPath $kitDestination
        if ($copiedKitFile.IsReadOnly) { $copiedKitFile.IsReadOnly = $false }
    }
    $payloadInventory = @(Get-PortableInventory $appImage)
    $inventoryText = @($payloadInventory | ForEach-Object { $_.sha256 + '  ' + $_.path }) -join "`r`n"
    Write-Utf8File (Join-Path $appImage 'INVENTARIO-SHA256.txt') ($inventoryText + "`r`n")
    $manifest = [ordered]@{
        schemaVersion = 1
        application = 'Spirit Gate - arena local'
        version = $Version
        windowsAppVersion = $windowsVersion
        builtAtUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
        platform = 'windows-x64'
        javaVersion = $javaVersion
        jpackageVersion = ($jpackageVersion -join ' ')
        mavenVersion = $mavenInformation[0]
        entrypoint = 'com.projetok.prototype.DebugLauncher'
        mainJar = 'app/' + $jarName
        javaModules = @($runtimeModules.Split(','))
        runtimeLibraries = @()
        testerKitFiles = @($testerKitSources | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
        stagingPolicy = 'Somente com/projetok/domain e com/projetok/prototype; sem classes legadas de banco/rede, testes ou configuracoes privadas.'
        inventoryPolicy = 'Manifest lista todos os arquivos exceto si mesmo; INVENTARIO-SHA256.txt exclui si mesmo e manifest.json para evitar circularidade.'
        testsExecutedByBuild = (-not $SkipMaven.IsPresent)
        cleanWindowsValidation = 'PENDENTE DE HOMOLOGACAO HUMANA'
        files = @(Get-PortableInventory $appImage)
    }
    $manifestPath = Join-Path $appImage 'manifest.json'
    Write-Utf8File $manifestPath ($manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8)
    $zipPath = Assert-ChildPath (Join-Path $distributionDirectory ($artifactName + '.zip')) $distributionDirectory
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $zipPath) { throw "ZIP ja existente; nada foi sobrescrito: $zipPath" }
    # ZipArchive recebe nomes POSIX explicitos; Compress-Archive no Windows
    # gravava barras invertidas, recusadas pelo auditor multiplataforma.
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression
    $zipStream = [IO.File]::Open($zipPath, [IO.FileMode]::CreateNew)
    $canonicalZip = New-Object IO.Compression.ZipArchive($zipStream, [IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
    try {
        foreach ($file in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $appImage -Recurse -File | Sort-Object FullName) {
            $entryName = 'SpiritGate/' + $file.FullName.Substring($appImage.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/')
            [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($canonicalZip, $file.FullName,
                $entryName, [IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
        }
    } finally { $canonicalZip.Dispose(); $zipStream.Dispose() }
    $zipHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $zipPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    Write-Utf8File ($zipPath + '.sha256') ($zipHash + '  ' + [IO.Path]::GetFileName($zipPath) + "`r`n")
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Destination ($zipPath + '.manifest.json') -ErrorAction Stop
    # Gate local: so anuncia sucesso depois de auditar o ZIP original, sem normalizacao.
    $python = (Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
    Invoke-CheckedTool $python @((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'auditar_rc.py'), '--zip', $zipPath,
        '--report', ($zipPath + '.audit.json'))
    Write-Host "Pacote gerado: $zipPath"
    Write-Host ('Tamanho: ' + (Get-Item -LiteralPath $zipPath).Length + ' bytes')
    Write-Output "ZIP_PATH=$zipPath"
    Write-Output "APP_IMAGE_PATH=$appImage"
    Write-Output "SHA256=$zipHash"
}
catch {
    Write-Error -Message $_.Exception.Message -ErrorAction Continue
    exit 1
}
finally {
    if ($transcriptStarted) { Stop-Transcript | Out-Null }
}
tools/checkpoint_rodada.py:
"""Registra checkpoints, diffs e resultados locais sem depender de um checkout Git."""

from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EXTENSIONS = {".java", ".md", ".txt", ".xml", ".py", ".ps1", ".cmd", ".gitignore", ".properties"}
EXCLUDED = {"target", "dist", ".git", ".task-checkpoints", "assets", "__pycache__", ".maven-repository"}


def state():
    """Lê apenas fontes, scripts e documentos textuais da rodada."""
    result = {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            for p in ROOT.rglob("*") if p.is_file()
            and (p.suffix.lower() in EXTENSIONS or p.name == ".gitignore")
            and not any(part in EXCLUDED for part in p.relative_to(ROOT).parts)}
    manifest = ROOT / 'assets/manifest-assets.json'
    if manifest.exists():
        result['assets/manifest-assets.json'] = manifest.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    return result


def checkpoint(task, finish):
    """Salva a base ou produz o diff e os hashes do estado aprovado da etapa."""
    folder = ROOT / ".task-checkpoints"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    path = folder / f"TASK-{task}-before.json"
    current = state()
    if not finish:
        if path.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Checkpoint inicial já existe: {path}")
        path.write_text(json.dumps(current, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"TASK-{task}: base salva ({len(current)} arquivos)")
        return
    previous = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    diff = []
    changed = []
    for name in sorted(previous.keys() | current.keys()):
        old, new = previous.get(name, ""), current.get(name, "")
        if old == new:
            continue
        changed.append(name)
        diff.extend(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(True), new.splitlines(True),
                    fromfile="a/" + name if name in previous else "/dev/null",
                    tofile="b/" + name if name in current else "/dev/null"))
    (ROOT / f"docs/TASK-{task}.diff").write_text("".join(diff), encoding="utf-8")
    metadata = {"task": task, "changed": changed,
                "sha256": {n: hashlib.sha256(t.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
                           for n, t in current.items()}}
    (folder / f"TASK-{task}-after.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"TASK-{task}: diff salvo ({len(changed)} arquivos)")


def results(task):
    """Resume os relatórios reais do Surefire sem copiar propriedades do ambiente."""
    reports = [ET.parse(p).getroot() for p in sorted(
        (ROOT / "server/target/surefire-reports").glob("TEST-*.xml"))]
    if not reports:
        raise RuntimeError("Relatórios Surefire ausentes")
    totals = {key: sum(int(r.get(key, "0")) for r in reports)
              for key in ("tests", "failures", "errors", "skipped")}
    if totals["failures"] or totals["errors"]:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Suíte vermelha: {totals}")
    text = [f"TASK-{task} - mvn clean test - BUILD SUCCESS", str(totals),
            "Windows 10 amd64; Temurin JDK 17.0.20.1+1; Maven 3.10.0.", ""]
    text += [f"{r.get('name')}: tests={r.get('tests')}, failures={r.get('failures')}, "
             f"errors={r.get('errors')}, skipped={r.get('skipped')}" for r in reports]
    (ROOT / f"docs/TASK-{task}-testes.txt").write_text("\n".join(text) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(totals)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

"""Adultera somente uma copia nova e exige recusa do auditor oficial."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import zipfile
from auditar_rc import audit, AuditFailure

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('source', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('report', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(args.output)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(args.source) as src, zipfile.ZipFile(args.output, 'x', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as dst:
        for info in src.infolist():
            data = src.read(info)
            if info.filename.endswith('spirit-gate-arena.jar'):
                data += b'ADULTERADO'
            dst.writestr(info, data)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(args.output.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    Path(str(args.output) + '.sha256').write_text(digest + '  ' + args.output.name + '\n')
    shutil.copyfile(str(args.source) + '.manifest.json', str(args.output) + '.manifest.json')
    result = {'checks': [], 'expected': 'FAIL'}
    try:
        audit(args.output, result)
    except AuditFailure as error:
        result.update(status='FAIL', negativeControl='PASS', error=str(error))
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('Auditor aceitou pacote adulterado')
    args.report.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Gera o guia de fixtures em PDF, preservando os exemplos Java sem dependências."""

from pathlib import Path
import re
import textwrap


PAGE_WIDTH = 595
PAGE_HEIGHT = 842
MARGIN = 42
TOP = 795
BOTTOM = 58
CODE_COLUMNS = 100


def _pdf_text(text):
    """Escapa texto português para as fontes padrão com codificação WinAnsi."""
    replacements = {"→": "->", "←": "<-", "≤": "<=", "≥": ">="}
    for original, replacement in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(original, replacement)
    return (text.encode("cp1252", errors="strict").replace(b"\\", b"\\\\")
            .replace(b"(", b"\\(").replace(b")", b"\\)"))


def _lines(markdown):
    """Interpreta títulos e cercas Markdown sem remover a indentação do código."""
    code = False
    result = []
    for number, raw in enumerate(markdown.splitlines(), 1):
        if raw.startswith("```"):
            code = not code
            result.append(("gap", ""))
            continue
        if code:
            line = raw.expandtabs(4)
            if len(line) > CODE_COLUMNS:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Linha {number}: código com {len(line)} colunas; "
                    f"divida explicitamente em linhas de até {CODE_COLUMNS} colunas."
                )
            result.append(("code", line))
            continue
        if not raw.strip():
            result.append(("gap", ""))
            continue
        heading = re.match(r"^(#{1,3})\s+(.+)$", raw)
        kind = "h" + str(len(heading.group(1))) if heading else "text"
        text = heading.group(2) if heading else raw
        text = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)", r"\1", text)
        text = text.replace("**", "").replace("`", "")
        width = 62 if kind == "h1" else 76 if kind == "h2" else 90
        indent = "  " if text.startswith(("- ", "* ")) else ""
        for line in textwrap.wrap(text, width=width, subsequent_indent=indent):
            result.append((kind, line))
    if code:
        raise ValueError("A fonte Markdown terminou com uma cerca de código aberta.")
    return result


def gerar_pdf(origem, destino):
    """Converte o guia em páginas A4 com títulos, código monoespaçado e paginação."""
    source = Path(origem)
    target = Path(destino)
    styles = {
        "h1": ("F2", 17, 24),
        "h2": ("F2", 13, 20),
        "h3": ("F2", 11, 17),
        "text": ("F1", 10, 14),
        "code": ("F3", 8.5, 11),
        "gap": ("F1", 10, 7),
    }
    pages = [[]]
    y = TOP
    for kind, line in _lines(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
        font, size, height = styles[kind]
        needed = height + (35 if kind.startswith("h") else 0)
        if y - needed < BOTTOM:
            pages.append([])
            y = TOP
        if kind == "gap" and not pages[-1]:
            continue
        pages[-1].append((kind, line, font, size, height, y))
        y -= height

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Courier /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
    ]
    children = []
    for number, page in enumerate(pages, 1):
        page_id = len(objects) + 1
        stream_id = page_id + 1
        children.append(f"{page_id} 0 R")
        objects.append(
            (f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {PAGE_WIDTH} {PAGE_HEIGHT}] "
             f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R /F2 4 0 R /F3 5 0 R >> >> "
             f"/Contents {stream_id} 0 R >>").encode("ascii")
        )
        commands = []
        for kind, line, font, size, height, baseline in page:
            if kind == "gap":
                continue
            if kind == "code":
                commands.append(
                    f"q 0.96 g {MARGIN - 3} {baseline - 3} "
                    f"{PAGE_WIDTH - 2 * MARGIN + 6} {height} re f Q".encode("ascii")
                )
            color = "0.10 0.20 0.32 rg" if kind.startswith("h") else "0 0 0 rg"
            commands.append(
                f"{color} BT /{font} {size} Tf 1 0 0 1 {MARGIN} {baseline} Tm (".encode("ascii")
                + _pdf_text(line) + b") Tj ET"
            )
        commands.append(f"0.75 G {MARGIN} 44 m {PAGE_WIDTH - MARGIN} 44 l S".encode("ascii"))
        footer = f"Spirit Gate | Guia de fixtures do dash | {number}/{len(pages)}"
        commands.append(
            f"0.35 g BT /F1 8 Tf 1 0 0 1 {MARGIN} 29 Tm (".encode("ascii")
            + _pdf_text(footer) + b") Tj ET"
        )
        stream = b"\n".join(commands)
        objects.append(f"<< /Length {len(stream)} >>\nstream\n".encode("ascii")
                       + stream + b"\nendstream")
    objects[1] = (f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{' '.join(children)}] "
                  f"/Count {len(pages)} >>").encode("ascii")
    output = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = [0]
    for number, obj in enumerate(objects, 1):
        offsets.append(len(output))
        output.extend(f"{number} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii") + obj + b"\nendobj\n")
    xref = len(output)
    output.extend(f"xref\n0 {len(offsets)}\n0000000000 65535 f \n".encode("ascii"))

"""Gera o relatório PDF da TASK-002 usando apenas a biblioteca padrão do Python."""

from pathlib import Path
import textwrap


def gerar_pdf(origem: Path, destino: Path, tarefa="TASK-002"):
    """Converte o relatório textual em páginas A4 com fonte PDF padrão."""
    linhas = []
    for linha in origem.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        linhas.extend(textwrap.wrap(linha, width=88) or [""])
    paginas = [linhas[i:i + 49] for i in range(0, len(linhas), 49)]
    objetos = [b"", b"", b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"]
    filhos = []
    for numero, pagina in enumerate(paginas, 1):
        pagina_id = len(objetos) + 1
        fluxo_id = pagina_id + 1
        filhos.append(f"{pagina_id} 0 R")
        objetos.append((f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 595 842] "
                        f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R >> >> /Contents {fluxo_id} 0 R >>").encode())
        comandos = [b"BT /F1 10 Tf 14 TL 42 795 Td"]
        for linha in pagina + ["", f"Spirit Gate - {tarefa} - página {numero}/{len(paginas)}"]:
            texto = linha.encode("cp1252", errors="strict").replace(b"\\", b"\\\\").replace(b"(", b"\\(").replace(b")", b"\\)")
            comandos.append(b"(" + texto + b") Tj T*")
        comandos.append(b"ET")
        fluxo = b"\n".join(comandos)
        objetos.append(f"<< /Length {len(fluxo)} >>\nstream\n".encode() + fluxo + b"\nendstream")
    objetos[0] = b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>"
    objetos[1] = f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{' '.join(filhos)}] /Count {len(paginas)} >>".encode()
    resultado = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = [0]
    for indice, objeto in enumerate(objetos, 1):
        offsets.append(len(resultado))
        resultado.extend(f"{indice} 0 obj\n".encode() + objeto + b"\nendobj\n")
    xref = len(resultado)
    resultado.extend(f"xref\n0 {len(offsets)}\n0000000000 65535 f \n".encode())
    for offset in offsets[1:]:
        resultado.extend(f"{offset:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
    resultado.extend((f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(offsets)} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
                      f"startxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n").encode())
    destino.write_bytes(resultado)
    print(f"PDF gerado: {destino.name} ({len(paginas)} páginas)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    docs = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs"
    gerar_pdf(docs / "TASK-002.md", docs / "Spirit_Gate_TASK-002.pdf")

"""Autoria offline; validação autoritativa usa LocalArenaMap compilado, sem outro schema."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def safe_path(root, name):
    path = (root / name).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or path == root.resolve():
        raise ValueError('Caminho fora da raiz autorizada')
    return path

def validate(path):
    if path.stat().st_size > 1_000_000:
        raise ValueError('Mapa excessivo')
    java = shutil.which('java')
    if not java or not (ROOT / 'server/target/classes/com/projetok/prototype/LocalArenaMap.class').exists():
        raise RuntimeError('Compile antes: python tools/qualidade.py --offline')
    result = subprocess.run([java, '-cp', str(ROOT / 'server/target/classes'),
                             'com.projetok.prototype.LocalArenaMap', str(path)],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=30)
    if result.returncode:
        raise ValueError(result.stderr.strip())
    return result.stdout.strip()

def create(root, name, width=1920, height=1280):
    path = safe_path(root, name)
    if not 960 <= width <= 8192 or not 640 <= height <= 8192:
        raise ValueError('Dimensões fora dos limites')
    values = dict(schemaVersion=1 if (width,height)==(960,640) else 2,
                  width=width,height=height,spawnX=135,spawnY=340)
    values.update({'physical.count':1,'visual.count':2,
                   'physical.0.id':'boundary','physical.0.x':0,'physical.0.y':0,
                   'physical.0.width':width,'physical.0.height':height,
                   'physical.0.category':'WORLD_BOUNDARY'})
    for i,layer in enumerate((0,6)):
        for key,value in dict(id=f'synthetic-{i}',x=32+i*128,y=32,width=64,height=64,layer=layer,rgb='245342').items():
            values[f'visual.{i}.{key}']=value
    text = '# CENARIO SINTETICO - SEM ARTE APROVADA\n' + ''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in sorted(values.items()))
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as output:
        output.write(text)
    return path

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--root',type=Path,default=ROOT/'docs/mapas')
    sub=parser.add_subparsers(dest='command',required=True)
    c=sub.add_parser('create');c.add_argument('name');c.add_argument('--width',type=int,default=1920);c.add_argument('--height',type=int,default=1280)
    v=sub.add_parser('validate');v.add_argument('name')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    try:
        path=create(args.root,args.name,args.width,args.height) if args.command=='create' else safe_path(args.root,args.name)
        print(validate(path))
    except (OSError,ValueError,RuntimeError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        parser.exit(1,str(error)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

"""Staging explicito de um personagem aprovado por SHA; sem alteracao da fonte."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
from validar_assets import inspect


def stage(root, manifest, output):
    config=json.loads(manifest.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    if config.get('packageVersion') != 1 or len(config.get('assets',[])) != 1:
        raise ValueError('pacote visual v1 exige exatamente um personagem')
    asset_id=config.get('assetId','')
    import re
    if not re.fullmatch('[a-z][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}',asset_id):
        raise ValueError('assetId estavel invalido')
    entry=config['assets'][0]
    if entry.get('kind') != 'character' or not entry.get('review',{}).get('origin','').strip():
        raise ValueError('personagem e origem da revisao obrigatorios')
    result,_=inspect(root,entry)
    if result['status'] != 'VALIDADO':
        raise ValueError('arte nao aprovada ou invalida: '+ '; '.join(result['errors']+result['warnings']))
    if any(f.get('durationMs',100)!=100 or f.get('pivot',entry['pivot'])!=entry['pivot'] for f in entry['frames']):
        raise ValueError('pivot/duracao por frame incompativel com runtime')
    # Pacote duravel usa nomes fixos, sem caminhos externos e sem fontes pendentes.
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    shutil.copyfile(root/entry['path'],output/'character.png')
    entry=dict(entry,path='character.png')
    config=dict(config,assets=[entry])
    (output/'review.json').write_text(json.dumps(config,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    values=dict(status='VALIDADO',packageVersion=1,assetId=asset_id,image='character.png',
                sha256=result['sha256'],approvedSha256=result['sha256'],
                reviewOrigin=entry['review']['origin'],frameSize=64,tileSize=32,
                pivotX=entry['pivot'][0],pivotY=entry['pivot'][1],offsetX=entry['offset'][0],offsetY=entry['offset'][1])
    for frame in entry['frames']:
        values[f"{frame['state']}.{frame['direction']}.{frame['index']}"]=','.join(str(frame[k]) for k in ('x','y','width','height'))
    # Properties: escapar controles, separadores e unicode evita reinterpretacao.
    def escape(value):
        return str(value).replace('\\','\\\\').replace('\n','\\n').replace('\r','\\r').replace('=','\\=').replace(':','\\:')
    (output/'character.properties').write_text('\n'.join(f'{k}={escape(v)}' for k,v in sorted(values.items()))+'\n',encoding='utf-8')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ('root','manifest','output'): p.add_argument(name,type=Path)
    a=p.parse_args(); stage(a.root,a.manifest,a.output)

"""Validação local completa: python tools/qualidade.py --offline --task 023."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def classify(code, output):
    """Códigos: 0 sucesso, 2 ambiente, 3 teste, 4 build."""
    if code == 0:
        return 0
    if 'COMPILATION ERROR' in output or 'Could not resolve' in output:
        return 4
    if 'There are test failures' in output or re.search(r'FAILED \(', output):
        return 3
    return 4

def junit_totals(folder):
    reports = [ET.parse(p).getroot() for p in folder.glob('TEST-*.xml')]
    if not reports:
        raise ValueError('Relatórios JUnit ausentes')
    return {k: sum(int(r.get(k, '0')) for r in reports)
            for k in ('tests', 'failures', 'errors', 'skipped')}

def run(command, log, cwd=ROOT):
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, errors='replace')
    log.write_text(result.stdout, encoding='utf-8')
    return result.returncode, result.stdout

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--offline', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--task', default='local', type=str)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}', args.task):
        parser.error('Identificador inválido')
    prefix = ROOT / f'docs/TASK-{args.task}'
    report = {'schemaVersion': 1, 'exitCode': 2, 'tools': {}, 'checks': {}}
    try:
        for name, command in [('java', ['java', '-version']), ('maven', ['mvn', '-v']),
                              ('python', [sys.executable, '--version'])]:
            executable = shutil.which(command[0])
            if not executable:
                raise RuntimeError(f'Ferramenta ausente: {name}')
            command[0] = executable
            code, output = run(command, Path(str(prefix) + f'-{name}-version.log'))
            report['tools'][name] = output.strip()
            if code or (name == 'java' and not re.search(r'version "17[.]', output)):
                raise RuntimeError(f'Versão/ferramenta inválida: {name}')
        command = [shutil.which('mvn'), f'-Dmaven.repo.local={ROOT / ".maven-repository"}',
                   '-f', 'server/pom.xml']
        if args.offline:
            command.append('-o')
        code, output = run(command + ['clean', 'test'], Path(str(prefix) + '-java.log'))
        report['checks']['java'] = {'exitCode': code, 'category': classify(code, output)}
        if code == 0:
            report['checks']['java']['totals'] = junit_totals(ROOT / 'server/target/surefire-reports')
        code, output = run([sys.executable, '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tools',
                            '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'], Path(str(prefix) + '-python.log'))
        match = re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests?', output)
        report['checks']['python'] = {'exitCode': code, 'category': 0 if code == 0 else 3,
                                     'tests': int(match[1]) if match else None}
        report['exitCode'] = max(c['category'] for c in report['checks'].values())
    except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError, ET.ParseError) as error:
        report['error'] = str(error)
        report['exitCode'] = 2
    Path(str(prefix) + '-qualidade.json').write_text(
        json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    summary = json.dumps({'exitCode': report['exitCode'], 'checks': report['checks']},
                         ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    Path(str(prefix) + '-testes.txt').write_text(summary + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(summary)
    return report['exitCode']

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

NAMES = '''grama

cerca-viva

arvore-cerejeira-02
predio-residencial-01
predio-residencial-02
loja
casa-telhado-azul-02'''.splitlines()


def rename_layers(path, mapping):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    header = bytearray(data[:128])
    count = struct.unpack_from('<H', data, 134)[0]
    pos = 144
    chunks = []
    for _ in range(count):
        size, kind = struct.unpack_from('<IH', data, pos)
        body = data[pos+6:pos+size]
        if kind == 0x2004:
            length = struct.unpack_from('<H', body, 16)[0]
            old = body[18:18+length].decode('utf-8')
            name = mapping.get(old, old).encode('utf-8')
            body = body[:16] + struct.pack('<H', len(name)) + name + body[18+length:]
        chunks.append(struct.pack('<IH', len(body)+6, kind) + body)
        pos += size
    payload = b''.join(chunks)
    frame = bytearray(data[128:144])
    struct.pack_into('<I', frame, 0, len(payload)+16)
    struct.pack_into('<I', header, 0, len(payload)+144)
    path.write_bytes(header + frame + payload)


def main():
    folder = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'assets/sprites/karakura-v3-extraidos-2026-10-18'
    manifest_path = folder/'manifest.json'
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    mapping = {f'sprite-{i:03d}': name for i, name in enumerate(NAMES, 1)}
    assert len(NAMES) == len(set(NAMES)) == len(manifest['sprites']) == 55
    # Verifica todos os destinos antes de alterar qualquer arquivo.
    for item in manifest['sprites']:
        old = item['name']
        if old not in mapping:
            continue
        for ext in ('.aseprite', '.png'):
            source, target = folder/(old+ext), folder/(mapping[old]+ext)
            if not source.exists() or target.exists():
                raise FileExistsError(f'Origem ausente ou destino existente: {source} -> {target}')
    for item in manifest['sprites']:
        old = item['name']
        if old not in mapping:
            continue
        new = mapping[old]
        rename_layers(folder/(old+'.aseprite'), mapping)
        for ext in ('.aseprite', '.png'):
            (folder/(old+ext)).rename(folder/(new+ext))
        item['original_name'] = old
        item['name'] = new
    rename_layers(folder/'karakura-v3-camadas.aseprite', mapping)
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    # Confirma pares, nomes das camadas e integridade dos pixels recortados.
    from separar_sprites import read_ase
    w, h, original = read_ase(Path(manifest['source']))
    total = 0
    for item in manifest['sprites']:
        sw, sh, pixels = read_ase(folder/(item['name']+'.aseprite'))
        assert (sw, sh) == (item['width'], item['height'])
        assert (folder/(item['name']+'.png')).exists()
        for y in range(sh):
            for x in range(sw):
                p = (y*sw+x)*4
                if pixels[p+3]:
                    q = ((y+item['y'])*w+x+item['x'])*4
                    assert pixels[p:p+4] == original[q:q+4]
                    total += 1
    assert total == sum(bool(a) for a in original[3::4])
    print('55 sprites renomeados em PNG e Aseprite; manifesto e camadas atualizados. Pixels verificados.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Fecha uma etapa somente depois da suite completa aprovada; sem Git ou rede."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from checkpoint_rodada import checkpoint
from gerar_pdf_task002 import gerar_pdf

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('task')
    parser.add_argument('--existing', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    task = args.task
    if not args.existing:
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tools/qualidade.py', '--offline', '--task', task], cwd=ROOT)
        if result.returncode:
            raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
    report = json.loads((ROOT / f'docs/TASK-{task}-qualidade.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if report['exitCode'] != 0:
        raise SystemExit('Etapa bloqueada: suite reprovada')
    document = ROOT / f'docs/TASK-{task}.md'
    if not document.exists():
        raise SystemExit('Relatorio da etapa ausente')
    gerar_pdf(document, ROOT / f'docs/Spirit_Gate_TASK-{task}.pdf', f'TASK-{task}')
    checkpoint(task, True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Recorta um atlas Aseprite RGBA estático, sem dependências externas.

Uso: python tools/separar_sprites.py [arquivo.aseprite] [pasta_saida]
Não redimensiona pixels. Exporta .aseprite, PNG e manifesto de coordenadas.
"""
import argparse
import json
import struct as st
import zlib
from pathlib import Path


def chunk(kind, data):
    return st.pack('<IH', len(data) + 6, kind) + data


def read_ase(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    _, magic, frames, width, height, depth = st.unpack_from('<I5H', data)
    if magic != 0xA5E0 or frames != 1 or depth != 32:
        raise ValueError('Esperado Aseprite RGBA de um frame; arquivo original preservado.')
    result = bytearray(width * height * 4)
    count = st.unpack_from('<H', data, 134)[0]
    if count == 65535:
        count = st.unpack_from('<I', data, 140)[0]
    pos = 144
    cels = []
    for _ in range(count):
        size, kind = st.unpack_from('<IH', data, pos)
        body = data[pos + 6:pos + size]
        if kind == 0x2004:
            flags, layer_type = st.unpack_from('<HH', body)
            if layer_type != 0 or not flags & 1 or body[12] != 255:
                raise ValueError('Use uma camada normal visível com opacidade 255.')
        if kind == 0x2005:
            layer, x, y, opacity, celtype = st.unpack_from('<HhhBH', body)
            if opacity != 255 or celtype not in (0, 2):
                raise ValueError('Cel vinculado ou opacidade parcial não suportados.')
            cw, ch = st.unpack_from('<HH', body, 16)
            raw = zlib.decompress(body[20:]) if celtype == 2 else body[20:]
            if len(raw) != cw * ch * 4:
                raise ValueError('Dados RGBA inválidos.')
            cels.append((x, y, cw, ch, raw))
        pos += size
    if len(cels) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Esperado um único cel: achate uma cópia do atlas antes de executar.')
    x, y, cw, ch, raw = cels[0]
    for row in range(ch):
        if not 0 <= y + row < height:
            continue
        left, right = max(0, x), min(width, x + cw)
        if right > left:
            dst = ((y + row) * width + left) * 4
            src = (row * cw + left - x) * 4
            result[dst:dst + (right-left)*4] = raw[src:src + (right-left)*4]
    return width, height, result


def components(width, height, pixels):
    mask = bytearray(pixels[3::4])
    found = []
    for start in range(width * height):
        if not mask[start]:
            continue
        stack = [start]
        mask[start] = 0
        points = []
        x0 = x1 = start % width
        y0 = y1 = start // width
        while stack:
            p = stack.pop()
            points.append(p)
            x, y = p % width, p // width
            x0, x1 = min(x0, x), max(x1, x)
            y0, y1 = min(y0, y), max(y1, y)
            for yy in range(max(0, y-1), min(height, y+2)):
                for xx in range(max(0, x-1), min(width, x+2)):
                    q = yy * width + xx
                    if mask[q]:
                        mask[q] = 0
                        stack.append(q)
        found.append({'box': [x0, y0, x1+1, y1+1], 'points': points})
    return found


def write_ase(path, width, height, pixels):
    name = path.stem.encode('utf-8')
    layer = st.pack('<6HB', 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 255) + bytes(3) + st.pack('<H', len(name)) + name
    cel = st.pack('<HhhBH', 0, 0, 0, 255, 2) + bytes(7) + st.pack('<HH', width, height) + zlib.compress(pixels)
    chunks = chunk(0x2004, layer) + chunk(0x2005, cel)
    frame = st.pack('<IHHHHI', len(chunks)+16, 0xF1FA, 2, 100, 0, 0) + chunks
    header = bytearray(128)
    st.pack_into('<I5HI', header, 0, 128+len(frame), 0xA5E0, 1, width, height, 32, 1)
    st.pack_into('<I', header, 18, 100)
    header[34:36] = bytes([1, 1])
    path.write_bytes(header + frame)


def write_png(path, w, h, pixels):
    def part(kind, body):
        return st.pack('>I', len(body)) + kind + body + st.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(kind+body))
    rows = b''.join(b'\0' + pixels[y*w*4:(y+1)*w*4] for y in range(h))
    path.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + part(b'IHDR', st.pack('>IIBBBBB', w, h, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0)) + part(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(rows)) + part(b'IEND', b''))


def main():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('input', nargs='?', type=Path, default=root/'assets/tilesets/karakura-environment-v3-blend.aseprite')
    parser.add_argument('output', nargs='?', type=Path, default=root/'assets/sprites/karakura-v3-separated')
    parser.add_argument('--min-pixels', type=int, default=150, help='Área mínima para um sprite independente')
    parser.add_argument('--fragment-distance', type=int, default=24, help='Distância máxima para anexar pétalas e fragmentos')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    w, h, pixels = read_ase(args.input)
    parts = components(w, h, pixels)
    large = [p for p in parts if len(p['points']) >= args.min_pixels]
    small = [p for p in parts if len(p['points']) < args.min_pixels]
    if not large:
        raise ValueError('Nenhum sprite encontrado.')
    # Ilhas internas (por exemplo, o piso dentro de uma borda em L)
    # pertencem ao mesmo objeto mesmo sem conexão de pixels.
    nested = set()
    for i, part in enumerate(large):
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = part['box']
        containers = [j for j, other in enumerate(large) if j != i
                      and other['box'][0] <= x0 and other['box'][1] <= y0
                      and other['box'][2] >= x1 and other['box'][3] >= y1
                      and len(other['points']) > len(part['points'])]
        if containers:
            # Escolhe o maior recipiente para evitar cadeias de anexação.
            parent = max(containers, key=lambda j: len(large[j]['points']))
            large[parent]['points'].extend(part['points'])
            nested.add(i)
    large = [part for i, part in enumerate(large) if i not in nested]
    original_boxes = [p['box'][:] for p in large]
    unassigned = []
    for part in small:
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = part['box']
        def distance(box):
            a, b, c, d = box
            return max(a-x1, x0-c, 0)**2 + max(b-y1, y0-d, 0)**2
        idx = min(range(len(large)), key=lambda i: distance(original_boxes[i]))
        if distance(original_boxes[idx]) <= args.fragment_distance**2:
            large[idx]['points'].extend(part['points'])
            a, b, c, d = large[idx]['box']
            large[idx]['box'] = [min(a,x0), min(b,y0), max(c,x1), max(d,y1)]
        else:
            unassigned.append(part)
    # Fragmentos distantes são preservados como arquivos próprios, nunca descartados.
    large.extend(unassigned)
    large.sort(key=lambda p: (p['box'][1]//32, p['box'][0]))
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest = []
    atlas_chunks = []
    rebuilt = bytearray(len(pixels))
    for i, part in enumerate(large, 1):
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = part['box']
        sw, sh = x1-x0, y1-y0
        crop = bytearray(sw*sh*4)
        for p in part['points']:
            target = ((p//w-y0)*sw + p%w-x0)*4
            crop[target:target+4] = pixels[p*4:p*4+4]
            rebuilt[p*4:p*4+4] = pixels[p*4:p*4+4]
        name = f'sprite-{i:03d}'
        for ext in ('.aseprite', '.png'):
            if (args.output/(name+ext)).exists():
                raise FileExistsError('A pasta já contém recortes; escolha outra pasta para preservar os existentes.')
        write_ase(args.output/(name+'.aseprite'), sw, sh, crop)
        write_png(args.output/(name+'.png'), sw, sh, crop)
        layer_name = name.encode('utf-8')
        atlas_chunks.append(chunk(0x2004, st.pack('<6HB', 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 255) + bytes(3) + st.pack('<H', len(layer_name)) + layer_name))
        atlas_chunks.append(chunk(0x2005, st.pack('<HhhBH', i-1, x0, y0, 255, 2) + bytes(7) + st.pack('<HH', sw, sh) + zlib.compress(crop)))
        rw, rh, check = read_ase(args.output/(name+'.aseprite'))
        assert (rw, rh, check) == (sw, sh, crop), 'Falha no round-trip Aseprite'
        manifest.append({'name': name, 'x': x0, 'y': y0, 'width': sw, 'height': sh, 'visible_pixels': len(part['points'])})
    assert all(pixels[i:i+4] == rebuilt[i:i+4] for i in range(0,len(pixels),4) if pixels[i+3]), 'Pixels visíveis perdidos'
    (args.output/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source':str(args.input), 'canvas':[w,h], 'sprites':manifest}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    write_png(args.output/'atlas-verificacao.png', w, h, rebuilt)
    chunks_data = b''.join(atlas_chunks)
    frame = st.pack('<IHHHHI', len(chunks_data)+16, 0xF1FA, len(atlas_chunks), 100, 0, 0) + chunks_data
    header = bytearray(128)
    st.pack_into('<I5HI', header, 0, len(frame)+128, 0xA5E0, 1, w, h, 32, 1)
    st.pack_into('<H', header, 18, 100)
    header[34:36] = bytes([1, 1])
    (args.output/'karakura-v3-camadas.aseprite').write_bytes(header + frame)
    print(f'{len(large)} sprites exportados; {len(small)-len(unassigned)} fragmentos anexados; {len(unassigned)} fragmentos isolados preservados.')
    print('Round-trip Aseprite e preservação de todos os pixels visíveis: OK')
    for item in manifest:
        print(item['name'], item['x'], item['y'], item['width'], item['height'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
